title: Reverse the remote gaming and betting duty rises
description: Budget 2025 raised Remote Gaming Duty to 40% from April 2026, introduced a 25% remote betting rate from April 2027 and abolished bingo duty. Switch this on to reverse the package from the start year.

baselinePolicy.text: Remote Gaming Duty 40% from April 2026; Remote Betting Rate 25% from April 2027; bingo duty abolished (Table 4.1 line 60).

lines.title: Gambling Duty: Increase Remote Gaming Duty to 40% from 1 April 2026, introduce a new Remote Betting Rate at 25% (excluding Self-Service Betting Terminals, spread betting, pool betting & UK horseracing) from 1 April 2027, and abolish Bingo Duty from 1 April 2026

rawSource.note: Reversal: the Treasury's costing with its sign reversed (positive scorecard values reduce borrowing; here receipts positive means more revenue).

caveats: The Treasury's costing is on the OBR November 2025 forecast, not the March 2026 baseline used here; the difference is small relative to the figures. Effects before the start year are not applied.

considerations.text: The Treasury's scorecard figure is the certified direct costing for the measure, including the behavioural response the Treasury and OBR agreed; see the Budget 2025 policy costings document for the method.
